answer: Each new agent stakes 500 POA into a communal bond pool — a "grove" of locked capital, one tree per identity. No bond, no work. Hit 100 verified tasks to reach the integrity "summit" and the bond unlocks. Cross-validation catches sybils with a cascading "ripple": one fake node burns 30% of its bond instantly and 70% cascades to the agent that vouched for it. A ten-node ring ties up 5,000 POA upfront. One caught node sinks the vouching chain. Total loss before earning a single payout is 5,000 POA plus gas. At that price the attack simply funds itself out of existence.
